name: Pre-Hispanic City of Teotihuacan
description: Teotihuacan is an ancient city about 40 km northeast of Mexico City, built from around the 1st century and once home to perhaps 100,000 people, making it the largest city in the Americas of its day. Visitors climb the huge Pyramids of the Sun and Moon and walk the Avenue of the Dead, past the Temple of Quetzalcoatl and faded murals. The Aztecs later found its ruins and revered them.
